description: Read-only lookup of an opt-in analyze_activity submission using the same caller/key. No URL fetches, writes or reanalysis. outcome_unknown is not absence and never authorizes a fresh execution. Requires durable idempotency enabled; private caller_token required for anonymous callers.

caller_token.description: Anonymous callers: private stable 32-byte cryptographic random token, unpadded base64url. Preserve before submitting; never expose in URLs/logs. Omit for API-key identity.

key.description: Stable per-submission random key. Same caller/key/input replays; changed input conflicts. Never reuse expired keys.

name: get_activity_submission
title: Reconcile activity submission
